title: Example 18-14: Diagramming Arrow and Emphasis

illustrates.quote: Arrows with Emphasized Words. When any of the words or phrases are connected by an arrow and are also emphasized, the arrow is placed above the sentence and points to the first letter of the emphasized word or phrase.

blocks.text: In the following sentence label *force* and *rattles.*
The *force* of the explosions **rattles** the windows.
blocks.features: Diagrammed sentence: 'force' italic, 'rattles' bold; a curved arrow above runs from 'rattles' to 'force'. Flush left.
